messages:
Anya: quick sync — aiming to onboard mpt-30b-quant-v2 to hosted serving this week. need 3 quick things: weights path + access, tokenizer sanity (any quirky tokenization that could break prefix cache), and a final quant-approach decision (AWQ / GPTQ / FP8) + calibration dataset approval. calibration used: 'calib_wiki_10k' (~10k examples). weights: s3://redwood-models/mpt30b/v2/quantized/sha1234. tagging the usual owners: @Rajal for calib, @Matt for infra/rollout, @Kim for S3/KMS. any blockers?

Matt: confirmed weights path exists and checksum matches. FYI storage policy requires access via k8s secret name `model-keys-mpt30b` (prod ns). to check locally: `kubectl get secret model-keys-mpt30b -n models-prod -o yaml`
Will do a canary rollout plan: canary=5% -> monitor token-latency and error-rate for 2h before 25% jump. need an infra PR to add model->route mapping, pinging @Rajal for config review.

Rajal: ran AWQ and GPTQ calibration runs overnight. quick notes: AWQ config (fast) gave ~1.8% absolute drop on our MMLU slice; GPTQ had ~0.6% drop but ~2x latency on 8k context. FP8 looks promising but we need runtime support and kernel validation — not green yet. calibration dataset: calib_wiki_10k (10k samples) + a 2k heldout eval. attaching minimal calibration snippet:```yaml
calibration:
  dataset: calib_wiki_10k
  seed: 42
  batch_size: 16
  num_steps: 625
quant:
  method: awq # tried awq/gptq
  bits: 4
  group_size: 128
```
If we prefer quality over cost -> GPTQ. If cost/latency matter -> AWQ. For FP8 we need another infra sprint.

Kim: S3/KMS checklist: bucket is private, but we need `classification=internal` tag and KMS key alias `alias/redwood-models` attached. also request that any public links are gated by presigned URLs and audit log enabled. can approve once tags + KMS are set. sample command to tag: `aws s3api put-bucket-tagging --bucket redwood-models --tagging 'TagSet=[{Key=classification,Value=internal}]'`

Anya: noted on FP8 infra gap. propose: do GPTQ for the initial rollout because product wants latency/quality tradeoff in favor of quality; AWQ remains fallback for cost-sensitive tenants. @Oliver can you confirm product preference? also @Matt please open the small PR for the route mapping and env var for canary % so SRE can change without deploy.

Oliver: product POV — lean GPTQ for now. quality delta is user-visible for our few high-precision flows; we can re-evaluate AWQ for lower-tier customers later. :+1:

Matt: opening PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2543 (config + secret reference + canary flag). tagging @Rajal for config validation. CI will run smoke tests.

Rajal: reviewing PR, will look at quant config validation and tokenizer edgecases (noted some sequences where tokenizer emits BOS twice under old tokenizer). suggestion: pin tokenizer to v2.1 and add a post-deploy tokenization smoke: `python -m tests.tokenizer_smoke --model mpt-30b --cases 50`

ci-bot: ci/pipeline passed for infra#2543 — all checks green, image build ok, unit tests 114/114.

Anya: sweet — final check: Kim, can you confirm once tags/KMS are set? Rajal, if your config review looks good we can promote canary to 25% after 2h of monitoring. setting owner list: rollout-owner=Matt, calib-owner=Rajal, security-owner=Kim. marking this thread as the single source for the rollout notes.

Kim: just added `classification=internal` tag and attached `alias/redwood-models` KMS key. audit logs enabled. you should be good from security side.

Rajal: config LGTM, pinned tokenizer v2.1, added post-deploy smoke test, and bumped group_size=128 for better accuracy. recommend GPTQ for initial rollout.

Anya: thanks all. moving to canary per plan — will watch SLOs and surface any regression. closing thread.
